Đề xuất benchmark/review (read-only), bám repo hiện tại:

1) Tách 3 benchmark, không trộn bằng chứng
- Synthetic exact: dùng tools/generate_synthetic_dataset.py (đã deterministic, 8 category shares 20/10/10/15/15/15/10/5, có image/clean_target/text_mask/bubble_mask), nhưng bản hiện tại chỉ 192x256, một font/"TEXT" và background đơn giản => chỉ smoke/metric correctness, chưa đủ production claim. Mở rộng từ >=100 clean pages/>=20 titles, font/ngôn ngữ/scale/blur/JPEG/perspective/stroke/halo; split theo title/book, dedupe perceptual hash. Lưu core text mask và removal mask (core + anti-alias/1–2px halo) riêng.
- Real curated: >=500 blocks/>=20 titles, 2 người annotate pixel mask + adjudication (ghi inter-annotator IoU); stratify bubble/flat/textured/complex/SFX/screentone/clipped/no-text negatives, text size/coverage. Không dùng OCR/detector box làm gold.
- Operational stress: COMIX manifest hiện annotation_semantics=detector-proposal nên chỉ dùng crash/fallback/routing/timing, tuyệt đối không dùng làm quality ground truth.

2) Metrics (báo macro/page/title + raw rows, không một score duy nhất)
- Mask: precision/recall/Dice/IoU exact + boundary-F1 tolerance 1–2px; false-positive area ngoài gold (theo predicted area và % page); empty/no-text FPR; bubble border overlap/damage. Báo core và removal mask để anti-alias không làm sai kết luận.
- Residual text: primary synthetic là reconstruction error trong core/removal ROI (Lab MAE/normalized residual ink/high-pass energy; output-vs-clean), secondary frozen OCR/text-detector residual rate (không dùng OCR duy nhất vì miss-detection). Gate gợi ý residual ink energy <=5% source residual (median), <=10% p95; OCR residual <=2% synthetic, <=5% real/human review.
- Edge preservation: Canny/gradient edge precision-recall-F1 và 1–2px chamfer so với clean, loại trừ removal mask; đo riêng ring 0/5/20px quanh mask để bắt đứt nét/halo. Initial gate edge F1 >=0.95 outside mask (complex lower bound >=0.90 sau pilot).
- Background fidelity: trong vùng cần khôi phục so với clean dùng Lab MAE (<=3/255 initial), SSIM >=0.97, LPIPS <=0.08 (optional); vùng unaffected phải byte-identical. outside_mask_delta==0 hiện chỉ chứng minh không ghi ngoài predicted mask, không chứng minh không over-erase: thêm outside_gold_delta/overreach bằng synthetic gold. Bubble-border changed-pixel fraction <1% (đúng gate plan), p95 <=2%.

3) Speed/memory protocol
- Freeze commit SHA, config_hash, model/checkpoint SHA, dataset_hash, Python/PyTorch/OpenCV/CUDA/driver, CPU/RAM/GPU; fixed seeds/thread counts, resolution buckets; paired same pages/masks. Measure decode, prepare/mask, erase/inpaint, composite separately (stress runner hiện bắt đầu sau decode, gộp prepare+erase).
- Warm: one process/model load + 5–10 warmups, then >=30 (prefer 100) pages; report p50/p95/p99, ms/page và ms/MP. Cold: fresh process 5–10 launches, include import/CUDA context/model load/first inference, report load and first-page separately (checkpoint local/hash, no network).
- CUDA: synchronize or CUDA events before/after inference; reset peak stats each sample; report allocated + reserved VRAM. CPU: child process RSS high-water mark/delta (tracemalloc một mình không thấy NumPy/PyTorch native). Count OOM/retry/fallback and calls by mode. Run CPU/GPU matrix on identical inputs; isolate inpaint with same gold/pred mask, and separately end-to-end.
- Current erase_pages chỉ erase prefix N => bias; run all/fixed seeded IDs. Current mean_coverage, mean_edge_touch_ratio, changed_pixels là diagnostics, không quality.

4) Acceptance gates
Hard safety: 0 crash/corrupt output; outside-predicted-mask delta = 0 mọi sample; bubble border damage <1%; simple uniform bubbles invoke LaMa 0 lần; unexpected fallback/OOM = 0 (nếu fallback được phép, tách rate + quality). Quality starting gates: Dice >=0.90 macro (hard strata lower bound explicit), boundary-F1 >=0.90, overreach <=1% page median / <=3% p95, residual/edge/background caps trên. Hybrid-vs-frozen heuristic hard-subset Dice phải định nghĩa rõ ‘15%’ là relative hay absolute (khuyến nghị relative >=15%, 95% CI lower >0; không để calibration test truyền hard_dice_gain mơ hồ). Neural phải Dice > hybrid và artwork-preservation precision không giảm >0.01.
Perf gate nên là paired regression trên cùng hardware: p50 không chậm >10%, p95 không >15%, peak RSS/VRAM không tăng >10%; absolute SLO chỉ ghi theo hardware class (ví dụ RTX4050/1MP: warm CPU <=250ms p50/600ms p95, GPU LaMa <=1.5s/3s) sau pilot, không áp chéo máy.

5) Chống kết luận sai vì dataset nhỏ
- Không pass nếu <1000 synthetic cases từ >=100 nguồn/>=20–30 titles, <500 real blocks từ >=20 titles, <100 stress pages; mỗi stratum >=30 độc lập. Repeats latency không tăng n quality. Macro-average theo page rồi title để page lớn không lấn át.
- Paired differences + cluster bootstrap theo title/book (10k resamples), 95% CI; binary failures Wilson/Jeffreys. P95 cần >=20 observations, p99 >=100; thiếu thì ghi ‘insufficient evidence’, không pass. Holdout frozen, threshold calibration trên validation, pre-register metrics/stopping rule, Holm correction nhiều stratum; lặp 2 seeds/5 grouped folds hoặc leave-one-title-out.

Evidence inspected: vision/metrics.py only exact mask arithmetic/mean evaluator; tools/evaluate_masks.py means rows with no CI; tools/stress_test_comic_pages.py has dataset_hash/config_hash, method/LaMa mode/calls, p50/p95 and predicted outside-mask delta but no stage timing/memory/gold quality. Existing rollout plan lines 15–22, 442–484 already calls for outside-mask=0, bubble <1%, hybrid hard Dice +15%, method matrix; above closes its biggest blind spots.

Đã đọc source + GitNexus. Luồng chính: app.py filter_ocr_blocks (343-411) gọi assess_erasability rồi upload lưu block an toàn; translate_and_render→render_single_image (573-616) gọi add_text.erase_text_region (legacy), sau đó render_all_blocks. app.py không import VisionPipeline (smoke: hasattr(app,'VisionPipeline')=False), nên config auto/hybrid/LaMa hiện chỉ dùng stress/new pipeline. VisionPipeline.prepare_page (59-88): segment page→normalize bbox→analyze_region→_match_bubble→masker.generate→score→_choose_erase_method; erase_page (98-205) batch union LaMa masks 1 full-page call, Telea/flat/preserve groups.

Heuristic: vision/maskers/heuristic.py build_text_stroke_mask (66-~158) fixed luma/color thresholds + adaptive threshold, component filter/dilate; fast deterministic CPU, good flat bubbles/uniform. Weak on gradients/complex art (false positives edges/lines), antialias low contrast (missed strokes), OCR bbox padding/edge components (fringe or border erasure), screentone dots unless dense grid. Legacy _erase_strokes_only add_text.py:742-827 removes dots, anchored components, flat sampled fill only low texture else Telea radius3; app path remains this.

Hybrid: hybrid.py generate 47-159: runs heuristic first; if heuristic coverage>0.15 returns heuristic-only; otherwise local median residual (gray+LAB), hysteresis low/high, anchor components, screentone filter, bubble safe-border gate, dynamic dilation 1-4. Better local gradient/anti-alias when low coverage, but residual sees panel edges/screentone; border clearing can trim text at ROI/image edges. Synthetic smoke showed uniform (coverage .159), gradient (.245), screentone (.321) all fusion_mode=heuristic_only => hybrid gives no gain for typical dense masks; large sparse gradient used heuristic_plus_residual. Hybrid coverage denominator is expanded ROI, unlike heuristic original bbox, so score/coverage thresholds not directly comparable.

LaMa: lama.py ResilientLamaInpainter full page then only on LamaCudaOutOfMemory contextual crop (_context_box), second OOM→Telea configured radius; build_lama_inpainter returns None absent checkpoint. pipeline catches any runtime exception and Telea fallback + warning. Best complex textured backgrounds but GPU/checkpoint/cost; currently not app production. pipeline erase_prepared_block (300-306) hard-codes Telea radius=3 for lama_full_page None runtime (ignores config telea_radius).

Bubbles: process_bubble.py legacy orphan (no app callers): process_bubble_auto→process_bubble/process_dark_bubble uses global dominant color/threshold largest contour and fills whole contour (flat, can destroy gradient); process_bubble_preserve_gradient (331-375) auto threshold 200/50 + dilation + Telea, no component/bubble gate, can classify gradient/art as text. detect_bubbles.py also orphan from app/new pipeline; YOLO raw detections + optional dark contour fallback. Long-image safe cut uses row mean white/black and no overlap in detect_bubbles_on_chunks→cut crossing bubble can miss; overlap fallback 200 and NMS IoU .5; dark fallback threshold50/area>=1000/fill>=.3 can miss small/outlined bubbles or false-detect dark art. Outputs raw [x1..] not BubbleInstance; no adapter.

Quality bugs: region_analysis interior ring samples bbox strips (36-77), border samples neighboring art; can misclassify panel edges/text as in_bubble; _match_bubble (370-376) picks any positive IoU and ignores config bubble.match_confidence=.45, so tiny overlap can invoke bubble gate/Telea. Hybrid residual + anchor can retain textured dots; _clear_crop_border removes radius pixels from every expanded ROI edge.

Đề xuất tối đa 3 hướng (đã chạy impact upstream trước từng điểm):
1) **Hybrid local-residual làm default cho OCR masks**, nhưng chỉ sau hardening screentone + bubble match. Ưu: heuristic fallback + gray/LAB median residual + hysteresis + OCR-anchor + safe bubble border; tốt hơn trên gradient/anti-alias sparse text, CPU. Nhược: gate coverage>0.15 khiến typical dense masks quay về heuristic-only (smoke: uniform .159, gradient .245, screentone .321 đều mode heuristic_only); residual vẫn có thể ăn screentone/line art, clear-crop-border cắt chữ sát mép. Fix points: _local_background_residual (impact LOW: 1 direct generate), _match_bubble (LOW: 3 impacted; hiện nhận mọi IoU>0, bỏ qua bubble.match_confidence=.45), remove_screentone_dots (impact **CRITICAL**, 6 impacted, 5 processes) và/hoặc _analyze_region (CRITICAL, 7 impacted, 5 processes). Rủi ro: đổi ngưỡng/filter ảnh hưởng cả app legacy + hybrid; cần benchmark pixel precision/recall + border overlap.
2) **LaMa full-page cho complex artwork, Telea/O fallback**. Ưu: phục hồi texture/gradient tốt nhất; pipeline đã union masks 1 inference, OOM→context crop→Telea, output chỉ composite vùng mask. Rủi ro GPU/checkpoint/latency; hiện build_lama_inpainter=None nếu thiếu checkpoint; app production không dùng VisionPipeline nên đang chỉ Telea legacy. Integration sửa render_single_image có impact **HIGH** (4 impacted, 3 processes; phải cảnh báo trước edit); erase_page impact LOW (3, stress main), _choose_erase_method LOW (3). Fallback hiện pipeline hard-code Telea radius=3 ở erase_prepared_block dù config có telea_radius; nên dùng config.
3) **Giữ Heuristic+Telea làm fail-safe cho bubble/uniform/CPU và thêm adapter BubbleInstance từ detector nếu cần bubble gate**. Heuristic nhanh/deterministic, flat fill cho uniform bubble và Telea cho texture; an toàn hơn LaMa khi mask confidence thấp. Rủi ro viền chữ/halo và complex false positive; screentone filter ngưỡng tiny_area=30,min_count=40,min_ratio=.6 dễ bỏ sót pattern thưa. process_bubble.py/detect_bubbles.py hiện orphan khỏi app/new pipeline; legacy process_bubble_auto fills largest threshold contour (gradient destroy), preserve_gradient thresholds 200/50 toàn ROI + Telea không anchor/gate; detector raw YOLO + dark threshold50, area>=1000, row-mean gutters, chunks at gutter no overlap, NMS IoU=.5. Nếu nối adapter: find_safe_cut_points/detect_bubbles_on_chunks/detect_bubbles_with_fallback/remove_duplicate_detections impacts LOW detector-local; prepare_page LOW. Need confidence/IoU/shape conversion, avoid false dark art and cut-through bubbles.

ENTRYPOINTS / FLOWS
- app.py routes: GET / -> home; POST /translate -> upload_file (ChromeLensOCR.process_batch -> filter_ocr_blocks -> either manual session or _do_full_pipeline); GET /correction/<session_id> -> correction_page; POST /continue-translate -> continue_translate (rebuilds blocks from modified_blocks then _do_full_pipeline); POST /ocr-region -> ocr_region (loads session, crops original page, OCR, returns {text}); POST /download-zip -> download_zip ({images_data} -> zip). SocketIO emit_progress emits phase/current/total/message/percent; keep event keys.
- _do_full_pipeline is called by upload_file + continue_translate, then snapshot_original_images, translate_and_render, build_result_images. translate_and_render batches translation, then nested render_single_image erases each block and render_all_blocks. CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION / GAPS
- Active app/CLI still use legacy add_text path; VisionPipeline is wired by stress tool/tests and imported transitively by add_text. prepare_page() gives one MaskResult per block, assess() returns stored decision, erase_page() unions lama masks for one page and uses Telea/flat fallback. erase_prepared_block() currently uses Telea for non-flat and reports LaMa compatibility warning for lama_full_page; page-level method is required for real LaMa batching.
- configs/vision.json is profile=cuda, mask_backend=auto, hybrid_gate_passed=true, lama_full_resolution=true; build_text_masker auto selects Hybrid when gate true, else Heuristic. No neural backend installed (requirements has no torch/onnx). allow_cpu_fallback is validated but not consumed by runtime; CUDA unavailability/model errors are only caught by page-level erase fallback to Telea. Treat this as a gap to fix in an adapter, not by changing legacy path.
- Spec confirms intended boundary: keep Chrome Lens/translators/rendering; prepare_page() sole mask creator; wrappers remain; uncertain masks preserve pixels/manual review; full-page LaMa first, context crop only after OOM; bubble segmentation once/page, optional when unavailable.

MINIMAL SAFE TOGGLEABLE DESIGN
1. Add a lazy, app-only factory/adapter (no top-level Torch import) that resolves VISION_PIPELINE_ENABLED/config. Default OFF => exact existing filter_ocr_blocks + erase_text_region behavior. Explicit backend/profile gates remain in VisionConfig; invalid or unavailable neural/CUDA falls back to Hybrid/Heuristic and then Telea with warning, never silently mutating output contract.
2. In enabled automatic flow, after existing bbox normalize/refine/merge and before translation, instantiate one VisionPipeline per request (or per worker) and call prepare_page(image, blocks) once/page. Keep PreparedBlock objects in an ephemeral prepared_by_image/index map; never put NumPy masks/model objects in session JSON. Add only JSON-safe pipeline/erasability summary if desired.
3. Pass this optional map into an internal render adapter (or optional final arg on translate_and_render); do not alter existing positional signature. For each page call pipeline.erase_page(image, prepared_safe_blocks) once (enables union full-page LaMa), derive existing appearance via region, then call unchanged render_all_blocks/add_text_bbox. If map absent, use legacy erase_text_region(image,bbox,source_lang) exactly; this preserves tests/monkeypatches and CLI.
4. Manual correction: do NOT reuse pre-correction PreparedBlock/masks because UI edits text/bbox and JPEG session round-trip. Persist only current all_ocr_results metadata/images + optional config/backend/hash; on continue rebuild normalized blocks and prepare_page from corrected original image. UI payload remains {image_idx,blocks:[{text,bbox}]}; no new required fields. Keep preview keys name/data/blocks,width/height and result keys name/data/original_data.
5. For safety-mode rollout, make filter_ocr_blocks(..., pipeline=None) optional. Default keeps current behavior. Enabled mode can retain uncertain blocks with _requires_review and exclude them from translation/erase unless manual confirmation; never erase an uncertain mask. Current code drops unsafe blocks at lines 392-399, so changing that behavior must be an explicit separate flag and regression-tested.
6. Keep SocketIO events and route responses unchanged. Propagate runtime fallback as existing warning string (or log) and continue returning translated.html; do not expose model objects or arrays to templates. Keep session path/TTL/cleanup and page_N.jpg naming; if mask cache is later needed, store per-session NPZ under temp_sessions and a relative mask_ref plus image/config hash, invalidate on bbox/image/config changes, and let cleanup remove it.
7. Keep main.py legacy default untouched; optionally add a CLI opt-in flag/env using same adapter. Do not wire detect_bubbles into production by default: it has no current upstream callers; inject a segmenter only when bubble gate/model passes, else _segment_page returns [] and classifier remains conservative.
